file_id: Mayejul Ali Khan @ Maijul Khan vs Unknown on 21 June, 2023

sentences.text: Mayejul Ali Khan @ Maijul Khan vs Unknown on 21 June, 2023

In Re:- An application for bail under section 439 of the
 Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Bagnan
 Police Station Case No. 08 of 2018 dated 05.01.2018 under
Sections 376/511/354 of the Indian Penal Code read with
Section 8 of the Pocso Act.

In the matter of : Mayejul Ali Khan @ Maijul Khan
 @ Mayajun Ali Khan
 ... Petitioner
 Ms. Minoti Gomes
 ... for the petitioner
 Mr. Debabrata Chatterjee, ld. A.P.P.
 Mr. Bibaswan Bhattacharya
 ... for the State

entities.text:
Mayejul Ali Khan @ Maijul Khan
 @ Mayajun Ali Khan
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
1.
Heard the learned Counsel appearing for the parties.
He defaulted in appearance on the date fixed for charge.
A petition by the defence Counsel had been filed before the learned court below on the ground mentioned therein.
Such petition for adjournment was rejected and W/A was issued against the petitioner.

The petitioner is stated to have surrendered before the court after coming to know about the issuance of the W/A on the next date fixed.
3. Regard being had to the facts and submissions of the case, it is directed that the petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 1st Court, Uluberia, Howrah in Special Case No.02 of 2018 on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case and on the basis of previous bail bond, if the security has not yet been discharged.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, 1st Court, Uluberia, Howrah
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is allowed.

(Chitta Ranjan Dash, J.) (Partha Sarathi Sen, J.)
